Maya (CS): Quick heads-up — Lina from Twilight requested dedicated pool bring-up next Tue. They need quota planning, autoscale thresholds, and a short loadtest window. Renewal in ~6 weeks; they'd like low-risk onboarding. Who can take lead?
Lina (Twilight): Thanks Maya. We need predictable latency under 95th p95 < 300ms for small prompts, and sustained throughput for batch jobs. Can we reserve a warm pool and run a 1hr soak with shadow traffic?
Alex (SE): I can own quota + loadtest script. Suggest initial reservation: 4x A100-equivalent slots (min_nodes=2, max_nodes=8) and a warmup schedule over 24h. Also recommend prefix caching enabled for common prefixes.
Raj (SRE): Autoscale proposal: scale_up when GPU_util >= 65% for 90s; scale_down when GPU_util <= 25% for 300s. Burst buffer allowed up to 10% over commit. Monitoring: hook per-node telemetry into Console -> custom dashboard.
Maya (CS): Lina — does that reservation align with your expected peak traffic? Any internal blackouts or PCI rules for keys we should know?
Lina (Twilight): That sounds right. We'll start with ~5k qps of small requests and batch jobs during nightly ETL. No PCI, but keys must use our KMS. We'll share service account + KMS ARN.
Alex (SE): Loadtest plan (short):
```
- 0-10m: ramp to 20% (warmup)
- 10-40m: step to 60% sustained
- 40-55m: spike to 95% for 5x bursts (simulate concurrent jobs)
- 55-60m: cooldown
```
I'll post the k6 script after lunch.
Raj (SRE): Add autoscale safety: fallback model variant (quantized) if latency degrades >30% for 3 consecutive mins. Alerting: p95_latency>500ms => paging oncall.
DeployBot: loadtest/job/1764518000 completed — result: preliminary smoke PASS, 4 nodes warmed, KV cache hit 72% :white_check_mark:
Maya (CS): Nice. Action items:
- Alex: share k6 script + exact quota request (today EOD)
- Raj: prepare dashboard + SLO alerts (tomorrow AM)
- Lina: share KMS + service account (ASAP)
I'll capture feedback during the enablement call and flag renewal risk if we see repeated throttles. :thumbsup:
Lina (Twilight): On it, thanks everyone. Appreciate the quick turnaround.
Alex (SE): Will also add a short playbook for ops handoff and rollback steps.
Raj (SRE): I'll run a dry-run of autoscale policies in staging tonight and post results.
Maya (CS): Marking this thread for follow-up — will update Jira ticket CS-7183 with the plan and owners.
